judgement_by: Hon. Vijith K. Malalgoda, PC, J (P/CA)
keywords: Debt Conciliation Board – Property transaction – Petitioner claiming to be bona fide purchaser – Original owner asserting transaction was a mortgage rather than an outright transfer – Allegation that intermediary transferee was fictitious – Two deeds executed within short interval for same consideration – Failure to call alleged vendor as witness – Debt Conciliation Board’s evaluation of evidence upheld – Court finding no reason to interfere – Notices refused and application dismissed. S. Thurairaja J. agreed.
legistation: Writ jurisdiction under Article 140 of the Constitution; statutory Debt Conciliation Board framework. The short judgment does not identify a specific statutory section.
